reviewed_properties: Typed canonical JSON reencoding plus unknown-field/trailing-data rejection; external config SHA is checked before output creation.
Selection fixes two target names, 82/252 regular files, 29/62 directories, and 842356/962496 payload bytes. No semantic inspection, label/role allocation or science transformation occurs.
Physical path separation, fresh output/restore names, no symlink ancestors, regular single-link files, exact selected device/inode/time/mode/SHA and whole-tree matching precede work.
Encoded cappedWriter is sticky and cannot exceed its supplied cap. Archives use O_EXCL, successful file Sync/Close and parent Sync. Failed partial files remain retained.
Restore writes directly into fresh exclusive files, without a decompressed-tar or duplicate temporary payload file; payload and inflated stream have separate fixed caps.
Gzip Multistream(false) on a buffered byte reader plus full capped drain validates EOF/CRC/ISIZE; reading one trailing compressed byte rejects additional members and trailing compressed data.

Tar validation checks safe exact inventory paths, duplicate/count/type/size/plain mode/UID/GID/link/xattr/PAX constraints and hashes; unexpected entries and nonzero remaining trailer are rejected. Empty files are restored.

All physical restored file bytes/SHA/plain modes and tree counts are verified; file/directory/parent Sync calls return before durable COMMIT. The COMMIT binds selection/admission/prior account/inventory/archive/restore before any original unlink.

COMMIT and marker pins plus archive hash are rechecked before original removal. Full source matching precedes captured-inode checks; each selected file is rehashed/restatted immediately before intent/unlink/parent Sync/ACK.

Only selected regular files and captured empty selected directories are removed; no RemoveAll. The source top root retains its fresh recovery marker. Phase two begins only after verified restore cleanup and CLEANUP-ACK for phase one.

Acknowledged counters advance only after journal Sync and output directory Sync return. An original unlink before its ACK sets a distinct possible-unacknowledged flag. Failures retain artifacts, complete=false, reclaim=null and automatic_retries=0.

Every retained control, marker and journal line is charged before write against one shared 128 KiB reserve; 2 KiB is reserved for captured stdout. In-memory event-size arithmetic gives 672 completed events / 67640 journal bytes, leaving 61384 B for other retained controls.

Current + archiveCap0 + restoreCap + controlCap and current - firstPayload + both archiveCaps + restoreCap + controlCap are checked independently. No compression estimate or historical accounting reset is used.

384 KiB prospective caps imply phase-one additional1572864 B and phase-two additional1123724 B only after all preparation artifacts are in current census. No encoded-fit or present-headroom claim is made.

main.go and run.go token sequences are unchanged after comments/format/separators normalization; archive.go differs only in import sorting/formatting. types.go changes input cap/plain guard; contract.go adds plain guard checks. Fake controls alone add path/cap/mode checks. No runtime budget or safety check was weakened.
No static Go compile issue was identified by source inspection. This is not compiler, fake-test or actual recovery evidence.
limits_and_Root_requirements: Root must independently format/build/run owned fake controls, pin executing source/tool/compiler, establish quiescent writers and exact selected identities, and re-admit the final current census and encoded caps. This review executed none of those operations.
Census/prior-account/helper pins are byte-bound, but their meaning, actual executing-tool correspondence and machine-wide completeness remain Root-owned prerequisites.

Tar matching establishes semantic inventory equivalence; it does not claim canonical tar bytes. Uname/Gname, regular-entry device fields, per-entry padding and interchangeable safe entry order are not canonicalized by the decoder.
Failure-summary null archive size never excludes retained partial bytes from Root census. A surviving journal row alone is not proof its Sync returned.
Output/restore reservations mean names and capacity; their directories must remain absent for the helper exclusive creation checks. Hostile concurrent filesystem atomic safety is not claimed.

Both target membership exclusions, retained enclosing accounting root, unchanged old25 archives and old20 mapping preservation are Root-supplied scope prerequisites. New directory recovery proof must remain separate.
